name: Parmjeet Singh
summary:
• Seasoned Software Engineer and Team Lead with over 13 years of expertise in PHP and full-stack web application development, adept at building scalable,
robust solutions using frameworks like Laravel, CakePHP and node.js, complemented by front-end technologies such as React.js and JavaScript.
• Insightful Project Management professional with extensive experience in directing cross-functional teams and managing all project phases—planning, design,
scope definition, estimation, and resource administration—while consistently delivering high-quality results within strict time and budgetary constraints.
• Skilled in leading end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) for multiple projects, including requirements gathering, design, development,
testing, deployment, and maintenance, ensuring high-quality deliverables and timely project completion.
• Proficient in database architecture and optimization, leveraging both relational (MySQL, MariaDB, MS SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB)
technologies to ensure high performance, data integrity, and seamless application integration.
• Experienced in cloud infrastructure management and deployment, utilizing AWS services—including EC2, RDS, S3, and SNS—to develop secure,
scalable SaaS platforms that enhance operational efficiency and reliability.
• Dynamic team leader and problem solver with a strong focus on mentorship, task allocation, and progress monitoring, driving collaborative work
environments that enhance productivity, while continuously adapting to emerging technologies and evolving project requirements to maximize
business impact.
